narrative.intro: Frequentis Usa has $298M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa won 9 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $33.1M, and obligations are up 90.8% year over year. Frequentis Usa grew from $8.4M in FY21, $7.6M in FY22, and $7.2M in FY23, to $34.3M in FY24 and $156M in FY25, before reaching $298M in FY26. Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing is the dominant market for Frequentis Usa with $283M in obligations. Frequentis Usa also shows activity in Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing with $9.6M, and in Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing with $3.9M. Frequentis Usa records smaller obligations in Engineering Services at $662K, Computer Systems Design Services at $100K, and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $55.2K. Frequentis Usa’s FY2026 totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the listed figures are contract obligations except where award-value notes are specified in the source tables.
